fixture: One existing Vorbis-stem fixture, same source loaded on all four decks; titles and paths retained privately.

runtime_checks.verification: same single LOAD; corrected native-basename oracle; JSON sequence comparison normalized

initialization_barrier: Fresh loaded-file mtime after current process start, current candidate mapping, same loaded set, then natural startup-marker absence. Restore helper requires fresh mtime before marker wait.
test_corrections: Initial readiness helper could accept a prior loaded status; detected before LOAD and corrected.
Native filename basename differs from UI title by numeric prefix; original oracle stopped before playback. Corrected verification reused the same load and PID.
JSON reload converts tuple to list; continuation numeric-mask comparison normalized container type before any playback controls.
limitations: One fixture repeated across four decks, one load event.
Telemetry fields are not an atomic snapshot.
Observed positions show native playback motion/pause; audio quality and audible stem isolation were not measured.
No four arbitrary tracks or low-memory refusal/retry/recovery/staging activation tested.
No physical device changes or validation.
No complete audio-reader lifetime, timing, or ordinary track replacement/ejection proof.
